objective: Collect Anthropic's official prompting guidance for the Claude 5.5 models into one cited reference file the instruction rewrite can follow.
scope: Find Anthropic's current prompt-engineering and model guides that apply to Claude 5.5 (Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5): docs.claude.com / platform.claude.com prompting best practices, agentic and subagent prompting, system prompt and tool-description guidance, and any model-specific notes for the 5.5 family (how it reads emphasis, verbosity, literal instruction following, examples, XML structure, parallel tool use).
Check whether the repository already names or summarizes such a guide (search packages/runtime/src/instructions, docs/) and say how its current instructions differ from the guide, briefly.

Write the result to /home/davidbasile/dev/holyagent-reviews/claude-5.5-prompting-guide.md: each rule as a short imperative line with its source URL, grouped by topic, plus a list of what is Unknown or not model-specific.
constraints: Read only in the repository; write only the one result file outside it.
Cite a URL for every rule; mark inference as inference.

criteria.text: Every rule in the file cites an official Anthropic URL, and model-specific guidance for the 5.5 family is separated from general guidance or named Unknown.

result: result: cited Claude 5.5 prompting reference at /home/davidbasile/dev/holyagent-reviews/claude-5.5-prompting-guide.md (134 lines).
